title: Understanding Model Risk
text: Model risk is influenced by three main components: model bias, model variance, and observational variance. Consider how each of these might be affected if the data collected is not truthful.

title: Observational Variance
text: Observational variance refers to the variability in the data that cannot be explained by the model. Think about how inaccurate survey responses might impact this aspect of the model.

hintAnswer: The model risk increases because the observational variance increases.
title: Impact on Observational Variance
text: If the survey responses are not truthful, how does this affect the observational variance?
choices: >The model risk increases because the model variance increases.
>The model risk increases because the observational variance increases.
